hotels.title: Tasmania French-Inspired Elegance near Hobart with Daily Breakfast & A$50 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Whisk yourself away to a quieter side of Hobart, where Villa Howden rests on the peaceful banks of North West Bay, framed by romantic gardens and Huon Valley scenery. This French-inspired boutique retreat feels far removed from the city rush, with elegant suites, water or garden outlooks and space to settle in whether you’re escaping as two or bringing little travellers along. Tuck yourself away in the library for a quiet hour or splash out on an in-room massage as an extra treat. Later, your A$50 dining credit gives you every reason to settle in the seasonal Tasmanian menu at Bruni’s Restaurant. When you’re ready to explore, Tasmania’s very best awaits - hike along striking mountain ranges, shop till you drop at Salamanca Market, ponder MONA’s evocative collection of art or board a ferry to Bruny Island, where fresh oysters and spectacular scenery await.
